feature_overview.business_goal: Allow admin users to manage the product catalog by creating, editing, updating, and deleting items.
scope: Admin can add a new item to the catalog with name, description, price, and stock quantity.
Admin can edit an existing item's name, description, and price.
Admin can update an item's stock quantity.
Admin can delete an item from the catalog.
System displays a list of all catalog items to the admin.
feature_overview.feature_boundary: This Architecture Plan covers only the Item Management feature and excludes unrelated features.

functional_requirements.description: Admin can add a new item to the catalog with name, description, price, and stock quantity.
Admin can edit an existing item's name, description, and price.
Admin can update an item's stock quantity.
Admin can delete an item from the catalog.
System displays a list of all catalog items to the admin.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given valid item details, when admin submits the add item form, a new item is created and appears in the catalog list.
Given an existing item, when admin edits and saves changes, the item's details are updated.
Given an existing item, when admin clicks delete and confirms, the item is removed from the catalog only if no active orders or carts contain that item; otherwise, a warning is shown.
acceptance_criteria.original_description: Given an existing item, when admin clicks delete and confirms, the item is removed from the catalog.

validation_rules.description: Item name must be unique within the catalog, and each product variant must have a unique SKU code.
validation_rules.original_description: Item name must be unique within the catalog.

validation_rules.description: Item price must be a positive number and explicitly stored with a currency code.
validation_rules.original_description: Item price must be a positive number.

validation_rules.description: Item stock quantity must be a non-negative integer.

non_functional_requirements.description: Item CRUD operations should complete within 2 seconds under normal load.
The admin interface must be responsive on desktop and tablet screens.
Only authenticated admin users can perform CRUD operations on items.
The system must retain a complete price history for each product variant, ensuring that completed orders display the exact price paid at the time of purchase.

architecture_approach.architecture_rationale: Use modular to keep the Item Management feature separated into presentation, business logic, and data responsibilities where applicable.
architecture_approach.frontend_overview: Frontend design should provide the user-facing entry points, inputs, states, and feedback required by the approved SRS.
architecture_approach.backend_overview: Backend design should process feature requests, enforce business rules, validate inputs, and return structured responses.
architecture_approach.data_overview: Data design should support the data requirements defined in the approved SRS.
architecture_approach.integration_overview: Integration design should follow the API expectations and dependencies listed in the approved SRS.
design_tradeoffs: Design is derived directly from the approved SRS to preserve traceability and feature scope.
Design is kept feature-scoped to preserve feature-by-feature SDLC development.
Internal generation or repair details are kept in backend logs and are not exposed in the approval-ready Architecture Plan.
